item.title: Karmelo Anthony’s lawyer asks for new trial in Texas track meet killing as new details are revealed
item.description: A Texas prosecutor who oversaw the conviction of Karmelo Anthony in the deadly stabbing of a track athlete during a high school meet says he and defense attorneys had agreed to hold back character evidence during the trial.
